## Activity

This report summarises activity at Hill Counties Health Centre during February 2020. The site recorded 52 captures during the reporting month. This figure represents the total capture activity reported for the site and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 52 captures, 5 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 9.6. This measure identifies the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading. The result should be considered alongside the total capture activity for Hill Counties Health Centre during February 2020.

## Grading

A total of 6 results were graded referable. The median lag for grading was 1. The grading results and median lag provide the available summary of review activity for the reporting month. Together with the ungradable result, they describe the recorded pathway from capture through image assessment and grading at Hill Counties Health Centre.
